findings.value: 0x0f 0x10 constant (candidate: 0x0f = 15 = magic strlen, 0x10 = 16 = header size); u16 BE @0x12 = N; @0x14-0x17 zero; @0x18 = 0x01; rest zero
filesize == 32 + N*128 EXACT in 3/3 files (N=120,120,60). N = duration/blocks; body = N fixed 128-byte frames

4-bit nibble codes, 2 per byte (hi/lo nibble histograms near-identical per file); N*256 samples; => 4096 Hz if N unit = 1/16 s, or 8192 Hz if N unit = 1/32 s (EPOC16 tick). Rate not independently confirmed
nibble 5 = silence; all three files end in runs of 0x55 bytes; leading frames may be constant-code (TETRIS_2 opens dd dd... = code 13)
nibble 2 NEVER occurs in any sample (histogram across 61,440 nibbles); codes {4,10,12,13} rare. Suggests codebook/compander mapping, not linear PCM. Mapping NOT solved
4.9-6.8 bits/byte per 1KB block; last KB of TETRIS_4 = 0.49 (pure 0x55 silence pad)
